raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Skip unnecessary CI for version-only updates such as deepspeedai/DeepSpeed#8871, which triggered CPU tests and native-op precompilation.

Make root  version.txt  a shared exclusion for both PRs and merge-queue entries, alongside existing documentation exclusions. Version/docs-only diffs skip CPU tests, native-op precompilation, and Python install smoke; mixed code changes still run normally. Required statuses, formatting, DCO, and scheduled/manual runs remain unchanged.

Reuses the existing filter; no overlapping open fix was found. Takes effect after merge, because CI deliberately runs the base branch’s filter.

Validation

•  python3 ci/test_tests_fetcher.py : 27/27 passed; the two version-only regression cases failed before the fix. Covers PR and merge-queue diffs, mixed code changes, and similarly named files that must not skip.
• Pre-commit passed on all five modified files; formatting CI also passed.
• Local validation: Linux, one Intel i9-10900X CPU, Python 3.10.8, Git 2.49.0. No GPUs or PyTorch used; training compatibility and performance measurements are not applicable to this CI-only change. Live post-merge skipping remains unverified.

 The active `python`, `cpu-torch-latest`, and `nv-pre-compile-ops` workflows use

+The shared gate also skips root `version.txt` changes on both PRs and merge queue

+changed path still requires CI unless explicitly excluded for that workflow.
+The Modal selector already selects no tests for a version-only diff.

 paths instead, which exclude Markdown. A README under a watched source directory
 cannot start these workflows merely because the PR also changes unrelated code.
